title: Blueprint Borough
tagline: Walk through a small town where every building starts as a blueprint, and learn how Java programs are written.

funFacts.text: In Java, 7 / 2 gives 3, not 3.5, when both numbers are whole. Java throws the fraction away unless one of the numbers has a decimal point.
Counting in a Java array starts at 0, so the first locker is number 0 and a row of five lockers ends at number 4.
Since Java 11 you can run a small program straight from its source file with one command, java Hello.java, and skip the separate compile step.
Java programs are compiled to bytecode, and the Java Virtual Machine runs that bytecode, so the same compiled program can run on many kinds of computer.

starRules: 3 stars: no mistakes and no hints. 2 stars: up to 2 mistakes. 1 star: you finished.
